name: @pipeworx/mcp-marketdata-app

tools.name: marketdata_option_chain
tools.description: Get the full option chain for an underlying stock/ETF/index, with strike, bid/ask/mid/last, volume, open interest, IV and greeks (delta/gamma/theta/vega). Filter by expiration, days-to-expiration, delta, side, and liquidity. Example: marketdata_option_chain({ underlyingSymbol: "AAPL", expiration: "2026-01-16", side: "call", minOpenInterest: 100, _apiKey: "your-key" })

expiration.description: Filter to a specific expiration date (YYYY-MM-DD) or "all" for every expiration. Optional.

dte.description: Filter to contracts with this many days to expiration (nearest match). Optional.

delta.description: Delta-based strike selection, e.g. "0.30" or a range ".20-.40". Optional.

side.description: Contract side: "call" or "put". Optional (returns both if omitted).

strikeLimit.description: Limit the number of strikes returned (nearest to the money). Optional.

minOpenInterest.description: Only return contracts with at least this open interest. Optional.

date.description: Historical snapshot date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a past chain. Optional (defaults to live).

_apiKey.description: Market Data App API token. Get one at https://www.marketdata.app/pricing/ (auth docs: https://www.marketdata.app/docs/api/authentication)

tools.name: marketdata_option_quote
tools.description: Get a live/delayed quote plus greeks for a single option contract, identified by its OCC option symbol. Returns bid/ask/mid/last, volume, open interest, IV, delta/gamma/theta/vega, and intrinsic/extrinsic value. Example: marketdata_option_quote({ optionSymbol: "AAPL260116C00150000", _apiKey: "your-key" })

date.description: Historical end-of-day quote for a specific trading day (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.

_apiKey.description: Market Data App API token. Get one at https://www.marketdata.app/pricing/

tools.name: marketdata_stock_quote
tools.description: Get a live/delayed stock quote: bid/ask/mid/last, absolute + percent change, and session volume. Example: marketdata_stock_quote({ symbol: "AAPL", _apiKey: "your-key" })

fiftyTwoWeek.description: Include 52-week high/low in the response. Optional.

_apiKey.description: Market Data App API token. Get one at https://www.marketdata.app/pricing/

tools.name: marketdata_candles
tools.description: Get historical OHLCV candles for a stock symbol at a given resolution ("D" daily, "H" hourly, "5" for 5-minute, etc.). Provide a from/to date range. Example: marketdata_candles({ resolution: "D", symbol: "AAPL", from: "2026-01-01", to: "2026-06-30", _apiKey: "your-key" })

resolution.description: Candle resolution: "D" (daily), "W" (weekly), "M" (monthly), "H" (hourly), or a minute count like "1", "5", "15". Defaults to "D".

countback.description: Return this many candles counting back from `to` (mutually exclusive with `from`). Optional.

_apiKey.description: Market Data App API token. Get one at https://www.marketdata.app/pricing/

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-marketdata-app forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the marketdata-app pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
